answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 49300 Country: India Title: Is Ghusl is compulsary if I had Ihtilam in night or shall I clean my sharmgah only and offers Fajr salah? Question: I had ihtilam in night and I perform Fajr Salah by washing only my sharmgah is it right or I have to do full ghusl? Answer ID: 49300 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1493/1493/M=12/1434) Ghusl becomes wajib due to ihtilam (wet dream). Thus, in this case the Fajr Salah you performed was not valid. It is compulsory to do full ghusl and perform salah again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
